title: MWC64-NATIVE: exact native resource envelopes of repaired fixed-fanin collimation

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2 N),the SAME fixed f64,x0=4999/80000 MWC algorithm fully specified in proof.md Sections2-12 with Section16 implementation clarifications and native-envelope corollary,including the exhaustive prefix n<2^4096,the actual Qcap and full odd/twoadic recovery,recovers the ENTIRE secret from independent ideal coset copies with unconditional success at least1-2^-8. All four bounds hold JOINTLY for this algorithm and complete success guarantee. Every displayed exponent coefficient,polynomial/logarithmic power is literal. The exact growth index is1/2. Full algorithm/proof and native substitution are in proof.md.
